name: Border Pest Control
description: Pest control company based on Rau Street in East Albury covering residential and commercial work. Services include termite inspection, treatment and pre-construction termite control, building and pest inspections, and control of rodents, spiders, bees, wasps, ants, cockroaches, fleas, silverfish and earwigs. Technicians work to AS 4349.1-2007 for building inspections and AS 3660.2-2000 for termite management.
highlights: Termite inspection, treatment and pre-construction control

name: Pianto's Pest Control
description: Family-owned pest control business working out of Sanyo Drive in Wodonga, with the office open by appointment only. Services cover termite control including baiting, monitoring, sprays and prevention, building and pest inspections, residential treatment for spiders, ants, cockroaches, fleas, rodents, bees and wasps, and commercial pest management. The business also installs gutter guard and does rodent proofing and exclusion.
highlights: Serves Albury, Wodonga, Lavington, Corowa, Rutherglen, Jindera and Howlong

name: Pest to Kill Albury
description: Locally owned pest and termite specialist run by Trevor and Narelle Weekes, who have more than 40 years in the pest control industry. Work covers termite treatment and inspections, spider treatment, bee and wasp treatment, and rat and mouse treatment. The service area runs across Southern NSW and North East Victoria, including Albury, Wodonga, Jindera, Howlong, Corowa, Rutherglen, Barnawartha, Chiltern, Beechworth, Yackandandah, Tallangatta and Wangaratta.
highlights: Covers Southern NSW and North East Victoria

name: Bradsworth Tree Services & Contracting
description: Locally owned tree company based at East Albury with qualified arborists and over 20 years of experience. Work includes Australian standard pruning, tree removal and climbing, crane removals, stump grinding, mulching, hedging, block and land clearing, vegetation management, tree planting and nesting box installation. The team also does tree health diagnosis, pest and disease control, elm leaf beetle treatment, cable bracing and 24-hour emergency work.
highlights: Tree removal, climbing and crane removals
Elm leaf beetle treatment and tree health diagnosis
Works across Albury, Wodonga, Indigo, Greater Hume and Towong council areas

name: Curtis Tree Lopping Specialists
description: Family-owned and operated tree business in Wodonga with qualified arborists and over 35 years of experience. Services include tree removal and pruning, hazardous tree removal, insurance work, stump grinding, hedge pruning, elm leaf beetle treatment and emergency callouts, and the business also sells mulch. It is WorkCover compliant and carries public liability and professional indemnity insurance.
highlights: Hazardous tree removal and insurance work

name: Albury Wodonga Cleaning Service
description: Cleaning contractor based in Wodonga offering commercial cleaning alongside carpet steam cleaning, upholstery cleaning, hard surface cleaning and pressure cleaning. Commercial work covers offices, banks, factories, medical rooms and industrial sites, scheduled outside trading hours on a fixed quote with the same team each visit. The service area takes in Albury, Wodonga, Lavington, Thurgoona, Springdale Heights, Beechworth and Wangaratta.
highlights: Office, medical and industrial commercial cleaning
Carpet steam cleaning and upholstery cleaning

name: Favourite Cleaning Service
description: Family-owned cleaning business with more than 18 years working across the commercial, industrial, office, medical and building construction sectors in Albury Wodonga. Services include commercial and office cleaning, builders clean up, strata and body corporate cleaning, display home cleaning, solar panel cleaning, window cleaning, carpet cleaning and flood extraction. It also handles concrete cleaning and sealing, bulk waste removal and event cleanup, and covers Thurgoona and Lavington.
highlights: Builders clean up and display home cleaning
Window, carpet and solar panel cleaning
Flood extraction and bulk waste removal

name: Albury Wodonga Carpet Cleaning
description: Family owned and operated carpet cleaning business working across Albury, Wodonga and surrounding areas for over 25 years. Services cover carpet steam cleaning, upholstery cleaning, tile and grout cleaning, rug and mat cleaning, mattress cleaning and 24/7 flood restoration. Technicians hold Certificate III qualifications covering carpet cleaning, stain removal, upholstery cleaning, odour control and health and safety.
highlights: Government accredited, Cert III qualified technicians

name: Albury Gutter Guard
description: Family owned gutter guard company servicing the greater Albury region. It installs aluminium and steel gutter mesh and states it does not use plastic products, and also fits fire ember guards, bird, possum and vermin proofing and solar panel protection, as well as offering gutter cleaning. Installations are done on tiled, metal corrugated, Trimdek and Decramastic tile roofs for residential, commercial and industrial buildings, with written product and workmanship warranty certificates provided.
highlights: Aluminium and steel gutter mesh, no plastic products
Written product and workmanship warranty certificates

name: Twin City Mowing & Garden Services
description: Locally owned, independently operated mowing and garden business and a member of the Independent Lawn Mowing Contractors of Australia. It covers residential, commercial and business lawn mowing, garden care and maintenance, pruning and hedging, garden cleanups, broadleaf weed spraying and rubbish removal. The service area is Albury, Wodonga, Lavington, Thurgoona and surrounding areas, with online quotes and bookings.
highlights: Residential, commercial and business lawn mowing

name: Dean Westmoreland Gardening & Landscaping
description: Locally owned independent gardening business that has operated across North East Victoria and Southern NSW since 1994. Work covers lawn mowing, maintenance and turfing, garden maintenance and beautification, hedge trimming and topiary shaping, new garden construction and planting, mulching, and winter rose and tree pruning. It also offers landscaping, garden design consultation and pest and disease management, serving Albury, Wodonga, Lavington and Thurgoona.

name: Kevin Hanley Removals & Storage
description: Furniture removals and storage business based at North Albury and listed among removalists servicing the Albury area. It operates under the name Kevin Hanley Removals & Storage and publishes its own website at kevinhanleyremovals.com.au.

name: Mini Storage Albury
description: Self storage facility on North Street in Albury offering both short term and long term leases. Units range from 2.5m x 1.8m x 3m through to 3m x 5m x 3m, sized on the site by household load from a one-bedroom unit up to a five-bedroom house. Access is through pin-code gates, there is an onsite caretaker, and customers supply their own lock.
highlights: Short term and long term leases

name: SureSafe Self Storage
description: Self storage facility on Bennu Circuit near Albury Airport. The site is unstaffed with 24/7 PIN code access, CCTV surveillance and high fencing, and unit sizes run from 1.2m x 4m up to 8m x 3m, plus container storage and outdoor secure parking spaces. Online booking, online quotes and online payments are available, along with goods protection insurance and courtesy trailer hire.
highlights: Container storage and outdoor vehicle parking

name: Border Storage Units
description: Self storage facility on Jarick Way at Jindera with insulated units, 24/7 CCTV and a security card gate system, and access seven days a week. Unit sizes are 3.0 x 3.0 metres, 6.0 x 3.0 metres and 7.0 x 3.0 metres, with outdoor space available for boats and caravans. Storage is offered for personal, commercial, vehicle and shipping container use, month to month with no lock-in contracts.

name: North East Bin Hire
description: Locally owned waste management company established in 2007 and based on North Street, Albury. It hires 250L, 660L and 1100L wheelie bins plus skip bins from 3.5 to 5 cubic metres, 8 to 10 cubic metres and 12 cubic metres, and handles industrial and commercial waste removal, business general waste and recycling, and Goterra organic collection. The service area covers Albury, Wodonga, Rutherglen, Chiltern, Tallangatta, Beechworth, Yackandandah, Wangaratta and the Alpine Valleys.
highlights: Skip bins from 3.5 to 12 cubic metres

name: Murray Valley Bins and Skips
description: Skip bin hire business serving Albury and Wodonga with three bin sizes: 3 cubic metres, 4 cubic metres and 6 cubic metres. Bins are used for residential, commercial and construction waste and take general household rubbish, furniture, green waste, metal, appliances, soil, rubble, brick and concrete. Bins are delivered up to 140km from Albury and can be booked online.
highlights: Takes green waste, soil, rubble and concrete

name: Wynns Locksmiths Albury
description: Locksmith shop on Urana Road, Lavington, that also runs a 24/7 mobile emergency service covering Albury and Wodonga through to Wagga Wagga. Services include residential locks and security cameras, commercial access control, master key systems, CCTV and alarms, and automotive lockouts, key replacement and remote battery replacement. The business holds NSW Master Licence 000105486 and is a member of the Master Locksmiths Association of Australasia.
highlights: Master key systems and access control
Master Locksmiths Association of Australasia member

name: North East Locksmiths
description: Mobile locksmith based on Thomas Mitchell Drive in Wodonga, open 24 hours a day and covering a 150km radius. Work includes automotive key cutting, programming, repair and replacement, residential lock fitting, repairs and upgrades, digital smart locks and keyless entry, restricted key systems, and safe installation, repair, relocation and digital conversion. The business holds NSW Master Licence 410782746 and Victorian Security Registration 680-117-51S.
highlights: Digital smart locks and restricted key systems

name: The Pool Boy
description: Family-owned pool maintenance business on Queen Street, Wodonga, with over 20 years serving North East Victoria and Southern NSW. It offers scheduled service calls, weekly, fortnightly, monthly or one-off servicing and cleaning, and sells and installs chlorinators, pumps, filters, solar heating and heat pumps. The pool shop also does equipment repairs, supplies replacement parts and provides free water testing.
highlights: Weekly, fortnightly, monthly or one-off pool servicing
Chlorinator, pump and filter sales and installation
Solar heating and heat pump installation
Pool equipment repairs and replacement parts

name: Albury Wodonga Handyman Service
description: Handyman and home repair business covering property maintenance, carpentry, painting, plaster repairs and gutter cleaning across Albury Wodonga. It takes both single call-out jobs and ongoing pre-planned property maintenance packages for homeowners, landlords and commercial operators. Free quotes are offered.
highlights: General home repairs and property maintenance
One-off visits or ongoing maintenance packages

name: Chant Holdings Liquid Waste
description: Family-owned liquid waste specialist based in Wodonga and licensed by the EPA in both NSW and Victoria, with more than 55 years in the trade. Services cover septic tank cleaning, treatment plant cleaning, grease trap cleaning, triple interceptor and oil separator cleaning, wash bay and pit cleaning, and winery and trade waste disposal. It lists 16 service locations including Albury, Wodonga, Corowa, Jindera, Rutherglen, Tallangatta and Wangaratta, and travels up to 120km for septic work.
highlights: Septic tank and treatment plant cleaning
Grease trap and triple interceptor cleaning
EPA licensed in NSW and Victoria
Travels up to 120km, including farms and remote towns

name: Riverina Horizontal Boring
description: Family-owned boring and drilling contractor based in Wodonga with more than 40 years serving the region. Work covers horizontal and directional drilling from 25mm to 1.5m diameter and up to 350m in length, rock drilling and bore logs, vacuum truck non-destructive excavation, bulk and detailed excavation, and underground utility locating and trenching. The business also does pipe welding and supplies poly pipe, and works out of Albury-Wodonga into Wagga, Shepparton, Griffith and Cobram.
highlights: Pipe welding and poly pipe supply

name: Worx Fabrication
description: Engineering and fabrication workshop in Wodonga that has operated since 2010 and serves the Albury/Wodonga region. It takes custom fabrication jobs and repairs to heavy machinery and construction equipment, and does onsite welding, fabrication and maintenance. Heavy fabrication work covers logging equipment, excavators, truck bodies, water tanks and trailers, and the shop also offers press folding, guillotine cutting and high definition plasma CNC cutting in mild steel, stainless and aluminium.
highlights: Custom fabrication and heavy machinery repairs

name: Steeltech Engineering
description: Metal fabrication and general engineering workshop on Bennu Circuit in Albury with over 35 years of experience. It manufactures in mild steel, stainless steel and aluminium, and offers CNC plasma and oxy-fuel profile cutting, laser cutting, press forming, roll bending, certified welding, sheet metal work and mechanical assembly. Structural steel, tank and silo fabrication, maintenance and labour hire are also offered.
highlights: Structural steel and tank and silo fabrication
CNC plasma, oxy-fuel and laser profile cutting
Press forming, roll bending and sheet metal work

name: Wodonga Pumps and Mowers
description: Farm machinery, pump and mower dealer on High Street, Wodonga, where farm machinery has been the core of the business for more than 28 years. It sells, services and maintains power harrows, rotary hoes, mulchers, hay rakes, slashers, grader blades, post hole diggers, cultivators, aerating equipment, rippers, disc ploughs and bale handling equipment. The workshop also handles pumps, lawn mowers, ride-on mowers, chainsaws and sprayers, and carries Silvan and John Berends Implements.
highlights: Farm machinery sales, service and repairs
Tillage, hay and bale handling equipment
Pumps, mowers, ride-ons, chainsaws and sprayers
Silvan and John Berends Implements dealer

name: In Home Appliance Repairs
description: Mobile appliance repair service covering Albury, Wodonga, Wangaratta and Beechworth. It assesses and repairs dishwashers, washing machines and dryers, including vented, condensing and heat pump dryers, in the customer's home. The business also installs and delivers new appliances and removes and disposes of old ones, and works on brands including Bosch, Miele, Electrolux, Fisher & Paykel, LG, Samsung, Smeg, Asko and Westinghouse.
highlights: In-home dishwasher, washing machine and dryer repairs
Heat pump, condensing and vented dryer repairs
Covers Albury, Wodonga, Wangaratta and Beechworth

name: Total Solutions IT
description: Computer repair business with an onsite workshop on Stanley Street, Wodonga. It handles PC and laptop hardware and software repairs, virus, malware and ransomware removal, data recovery from hard drives, SSDs and USB devices, operating system repairs and hardware replacement and upgrades. Other work includes home Wi-Fi setup and troubleshooting, new computer setup and custom builds, security hardening and printer and scanner installation.
highlights: Data recovery from HDD, SSD and USB
Custom PC builds and new computer setup

name: Moff IT
description: Repair shop on Guinea Street, Albury, that works on phones, tablets and computers. Services include screen and battery replacements, water damage restoration including MacBooks, device diagnostics, data recovery from damaged devices, and insurance assessments with documentation. Callouts are offered for business and residential clients, repairs carry a three month warranty and refurbished computers carry six months.
highlights: Phone, tablet and computer screen replacement

name: The Phone Repair Centre
description: Phone and tablet repair shop on Mate Street in North Albury that has been repairing phones and iPads in the Albury Wodonga area since 2009. It does Apple, Samsung and other brand screen repairs, and iPad repairs, with same day screen repairs available depending on stock. No appointment is required and repairs are backed by a three month warranty on parts and workmanship.
highlights: iPhone, Samsung and other brand screen repairs
Same day screen repairs subject to stock
